title: Fireside Chat: Strategic Materials Security: Building a Western-Aligned Midstream Corridor from the DRC
gist: The text is a member-only video listing page, not a transcript: a 32-minute Giga Africa 2026 fireside chat between Benchmark COO Caspar Rawles and Buenassa CEO Eddy Kioni on building a Western-aligned midstream (processing) corridor out of the DRC. No discussion content is included.

insights.claim: Buenassa, a DRC company, is positioned around building a Western-aligned midstream processing corridor from the DRC as a strategic-materials-security play.
insights.speaker: Eddy Kioni, CEO, Buenassa
insights.so_what: Local DRC refining aligned with Western offtakers is pitched as an alternative to shipping concentrate to Chinese refiners.
insights.quote: Strategic Materials Security: Building a Western-Aligned Midstream Corridor from the DRC

insights.claim: Framing the DRC opportunity as 'midstream' rather than mining signals the policy focus has moved to processing capacity as the supply-chain chokepoint.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Minerals
insights.so_what: Capital and policy support are likely to flow toward DRC refining/processing projects rather than new mines alone.

insights.claim: The fireside sits in a Giga Africa 2026 programme that also features a U.S. Department of Energy keynote on onshoring and financing minerals and midstream projects.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Minerals
insights.so_what: U.S. government finance is a likely counterpart for Western-aligned DRC midstream projects.
insights.quote: Keynote Presentation: How the U.S. is Leading the Onshoring and Financing of Minerals and Midstream Projects

source_meta.author: Caspar Rawles , Chief Operating Officer , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Eddy Kioni , CEO , Buenassa
